about: Lab scenarios for the console's Lab tab (BACKLOG B13). A wish is the game's own cheat prompt (Ctrl+W, or Shift+W for a menu; verified in Commands.xml). The prompt takes ONE line: paste or type one wish at a time. Use a throwaway character with the AI paused. Wish kinds: 'blueprint' = the creature or item name typed alone (verified in game 2026-10-08: SecurityTurret spawned one; the 'spawn:' prefix did NOT work, the log said Unknown blueprint); 'command' = a named wish. Confidence: 'verified' = seen working in the game, 'documented' = labelled in the game's WishCommands.xml, 'named' = the string is recognised by the wish handler but its effect was not read.

scenarios.title: Turret nest
scenarios.why: Test the turret doctrine (HANDOFF issue 77) without waiting for a run that meets one: a turret listed as an enemy, shot with Lase, never rested in front of.
setup: Pause the AI and find open floor with at least 8 clear tiles in one direction.

Wishes put a creature in the first empty cell NEXT TO YOU: there is no distance setting. So: turn godmode on, spawn the turret, walk the distance you want (5 or 6 tiles, in its line of sight), turn godmode off, then Engage the AI.
Copy and enter the lines in order, one at a time (the Copy button gives the next one each click): godmode, the turret, then walk, then godmode again.

wishes.note: turn it ON first so the turret's first shots cannot hurt you while you walk away ('Toggle godmode' in the game's menu; not yet seen working by us)
verified in game: one musket turret appeared (level 15, 5 HP), next to you
after you have walked 5 or 6 tiles away: the same wish again turns it OFF. Do not forget, or the test proves nothing

watch: [TURRET] lines in the brain console
the turret in last_state.json with is_enemy true and max_hp 5
a Lase aimed at the turret, then the turret gone
no REST while it has line of sight

scenarios.title: Very Tough creature next to you
scenarios.why: Test the lethal adjacent guard (issue 75): Teleport Other, Force Bubble or Intimidate instead of Lase.
setup: Pause the AI. Use a character of level 3 to 5 with at least one of those abilities ready.
Wish for the creature, then Engage.

wishes.note: level 12, 45 HP; Very Tough for a level 3 to 5 character (typed alone; untried, tell me what it did)

watch: [LETHAL GUARD] line
the creature gone or controlled on the first turn

scenarios.title: Proselytize odds by level gap
scenarios.why: Fill memory/proselytize_log.jsonl quickly (BACKLOG B11): attempts on calm creatures at known levels, with the 25-turn cooldown cleared between tries.
setup: Pause the AI. Wish for a calm creature next to you, Engage, wait for the [PROSELYTIZE] line, Pause, clear the cooldown, repeat.

wishes.note: a calm level 1 or 2 animal (typed alone; untried, tell me what it did)
level 5, hostile by faction (typed alone; untried, tell me what it did)
level 7 (typed alone; untried, tell me what it did)

watch: [PROSELYTIZE] recruited or not_recruited lines
the report's rate per level gap

scenarios.title: Set the character's level
scenarios.why: Reach a level (to test a level-gated rule such as the dive gates) without grinding. The XP needed comes from the game's own curve (ENGINE_INTERNALS 14.16); the tab computes how much to add from your current XP.
setup: Pause the AI. Pick the level in the tab; it shows the exact wish.

wishes.note: the game's own menu has 'Gain 25,000 XP' as xp:25000, so the amount after the colon is XP to add; level-ups still need to be taken (AP, SP, mutations) by the brain or by you

watch: the level in the state
the brain spending the new attribute and skill points

scenarios.title: Quiet walk (navigation and exits)
scenarios.why: Test exploration, exit and stairs logic (issues 71, 73, 74) without being killed halfway: calm creatures, or an invulnerable character.
setup: Pause the AI. Wish, then Engage and watch the Live actions tab.

wishes.note: 'Toggle godmode'; wish again to turn it off. Do not leave it on for a run you want to count

watch: AUTOEXPLORE rows
USE_STAIRS_UP from a dead-end stratum, and no walk straight back down

scenarios.title: Give an item (trade and gear tests)
scenarios.why: Test the item scorer and inventory actions (issues 66, 72) and trade ideas (B8) with an item you name.
setup: Pause the AI. Wish for the item, then Engage and read the [INVENTORY] lines.

wishes.note: the game's menu spawns items with item:<Blueprint>; the blueprint names are in data/items.json
an item worth 200 base, for the sell side of a trade

watch: equip or drop decisions
that a gifted firearm is kept (Test 93)

scenarios.title: Quest state (quest log tests)
scenarios.why: Check the quest log export and the [QUEST] lines (issue 76) for a quest you did not take by hand.
setup: Pause the AI. Wish, Engage for a few turns, open the Quests tab.

wishes.note: the quest name is the one in Quests.xml

wishes.cmd: finishqueststep:What's Eating the Watervine?~Travel to Red Rock
wishes.note: the step id format 'Quest~Step' appears in the game's conversations; the exact wish syntax was not read

watch: the quest in the Quests tab
a [QUEST] new quest or step finished line

scenarios.title: Equipment on the ground (B16)
scenarios.why: Check that he fetches and wears a clear armor upgrade lying on the ground (issue 96), and ignores one that is not an upgrade.
setup: Quiet zone, no hostiles in view, the AI paused. Note what he wears (armor value on the Live tab or in last_state.json: av, dv).
Wish the first item, engage the AI and watch. Pause, then try the second.

wishes.note: armor AV 3, DV -1: a clear upgrade over a cloth robe by the inventory scorer; an item wish drops it next to you
AV 2, DV -1: by the scorer NOT an upgrade over a cloth robe (it misses the 2.0 margin); he should leave it

watch: a [INVENTORY] took chain mail from the ground line, then [INVENTORY] equipped chain mail
last_state.json: ground_items lists the item, av goes up, the old robe is dropped by the inventory step
no pickup and drop ping-pong (the dropped robe must not be fetched again)
